Two signal-loss rules: 7.4 'more than 500 ms' and 10.2 'three times its cycle time' can conflict.
Startup timing: 3.1 ACTIVE within 1.5 s of IGN ON vs 15.1 first frame within 2 s of undefined 'power-up'.
DTC storage appears in 7.4 (TT section) and 11.1 (DIAG section); G22 sits under TT by section mapping.
